Package hadur117.core.shieldmode

Class ShieldList

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.shieldmode.ShieldList
public final class ShieldList extends Object
The opponents shield mode applies to (SHIELD-5): Hadur's own list, read by the adapter from a class in the robot jar and handed to the core as lines of text. The core does no I/O (RES-6), so this class only parses and matches.

One robot per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. A line is a robot's name as Robocode lists it, package.Class version, or the name alone without the version. A name alone matches every version of the robot (apv.test.Virus matches apv.test.Virus 0.6.1 and any other); a name with a version matches that version only, so a robot that changes its aim in a new release is not on the list until the bench says so. Matching is exact and case-sensitive: never a prefix, so apv.test.Virus does not match apv.test.VirusX. Runs of white space in a line count as one space.

Two more kinds of line, matched by the same rule (SHIELD-17, SHIELD-18): shield-move: name names an opponent the shield's opening drive is for, and shield-aim: predictor offset name gives an opponent's shipped aim, its best predictor (from 0) and that predictor's offset in radians. A malformed aim line is skipped.

At most MAX_ENTRIES entries of each kind are kept (RES-2).
